notes: Converted from MAME's src/mame/sega/nl_segas16b.cpp (NETLIST_START(segas16b_audio), CC0-1.0, Couriersud) at mame0289 by tools/mame_netlist.py. Every change from MAME's file -- the simulation stand-ins undone, the hacks dropped, the corrections from the sheet -- is logged at the top of boards/segas16b-audio.nets.

MAME's file marks its own doubts, and they are kept as it has them. It puts the mixer stage on XC20 pins 9, 8 and 10 where, its comments say, the schematic reads 9, 7 and 8 -- 7 is already the speech filter's output, so MAME moved the stage onto the third section and asks 'other AMP?' of each. C19 and C22 'need verification', and the op-amps' supply is assumed: 'no information on schematics, assume 12V'. The site holds no System 16B schematic to settle any of it.

Not compared with the sheet. MAME's designators, values and pin numbers are taken as MAME has them; the checker shows the netlist is internally consistent (every pin exists, no two outputs fight, nothing floats), which is not the same as matching the board.
